description: i018 (SNAPSHOT=s02, BRANCH=gro-frag-stale-ptr) complete. Finding: s02:net/ipv4/udp_offload.c:26-46 __skb_udp_tunnel_segment (medium confidence). Untrusted source: UDP-tunnel GSO super-packets (vxlan/geneve/fou, SKB_GSO_UDP_TUNNEL[_CSUM]) whose outer UDP header bytes are attacker-influenced forwarded traffic. Violated invariant: uh = udp_hdr(skb) captured at line 26, a raw pointer into skb->head; pskb_may_pull(skb, tnl_hlen) at line 33 calls __pskb_pull_tail (net/core/skbuff.c:1604) which invokes pskb_expand_head and frees/replaces skb->head for a cloned/non-linear skb; no reload of uh between pull and use. Unsafe use: stale uh->len read at line 43 (SKB_GSO_PARTIAL branch) and uh->check read at line 46 compute 'partial', which is folded into every segment's transmitted UDP checksum at lines 133-140 (uh refetched only at line 116 after segmentation) — freed-slabslab read whose value flows into transmitted packet bytes, the seed's capture->reallocating-pull->stale-use class on the GSO segmenter. Verified line-by-line in s02 (same function previously reported for s01 by f005; this is the s02 instance). Bounded negative evidence: every other GRO/GSO/frag-list site in s02 was deep-read and classified safe — tcp_gro_receive, udp_gro_receive/udp4/udp6_gro_receive, inet_gro_receive, ipv6_gro_receive, gre_gro_receive, gue_gro_receive (remcsum helper returns refetched pointer), vxlan_gro_receive, geneve_gro_receive, vlan/eth_gro_receive, napi_frags_skb/gro_pull_from_frag0 in net/core/dev.c, skb_segment frag-list walker + tcp_gso_segment (cow applies to the cloned nskb, list pointers re-derived; th refetched post-segment), and the frag walkers ip6_frag_queue, nf_ct_frag6_queue/gather, strp_recv — all show either refetch-after-pull discipline, offset-only skb_gro_pull, or operate on sk_buff list pointers rather than head pointers. Limitations: no runtime KASAN reproducer (reallocation precondition argued from pskb_expand_head semantics); the heuristic scanner only catches same-function type*var= captures; drivers/ beyond vxlan/geneve pattern-screened (they are the only drivers/ users of gro header helpers); batman-adv/mac80211 cow sites excluded per intent (covered by i007); no network access to compare upstream fix status.
